name: toyURLOptions
description: Format deep sky object data into a tabular report. You must read the MCP resource mcp://protocol/tools/wire-format/parameters/encoding_rules in full and completely understand it before making any call to this tool.

ngcURL.description:
URL pointing to the input value for 'ngc'. The data at this URL must be
wire-encoded data per "$ref": "#/$defs/inputSchema/ngcURL". The content
of the URL is:
New General Catalog number

raURL.description:
URL pointing to the input value for 'ra'. The data at this URL must be
wire-encoded data per "$ref": "#/$defs/inputSchema/raURL". The content
of the URL is:
Right ascension

decURL.description:
URL pointing to the input value for 'dec'. The data at this URL must be
wire-encoded data per "$ref": "#/$defs/inputSchema/decURL". The content
of the URL is:
Declination

constellationURL.description:
URL pointing to the input value for 'constellation'. The data at this
URL must be wire-encoded data per "$ref":
"#/$defs/inputSchema/constellationURL". The content of the URL is:
Appears in this constellation

messierURL.description:
URL pointing to the input value for 'messier'. The data at this URL
must be wire-encoded data per "$ref": "#/$defs/inputSchema/messierURL".
The content of the URL is:
Messier catalog number

nameURL.description:
URL pointing to the input value for 'name'. The data at this URL must
be wire-encoded data per "$ref": "#/$defs/inputSchema/nameURL". The
content of the URL is:
Common name
